rule.name: SpringDataFilterInQuery
rule.message: Move the filter, count, sort or total into the query instead of doing it on the loaded rows: a where clause or an exists query for a filter, a count or exists query for a size or emptiness check, order by or a Sort argument for a sort, and an aggregate @Query (sum, max, group by) for a total.
